title: Enable the UFW firewall
summary: Turn on the Uncomplicated Firewall (UFW) to protect your Linux system from unauthorized network access. This command reloads the firewall rules and ensures they are active immediately and on every boot.

steps.explain: Run the command to reload and enable the UFW firewall. You may be prompted to confirm that you want to proceed, as this can disconnect existing SSH sessions if not configured correctly.
steps.expect: The firewall is active and rules are loaded.

rollback.explain: Disable the firewall if you need to restore unrestricted network access.

warnings: Enabling the firewall may block existing connections, including remote SSH sessions. Ensure you have physical access or have configured UFW to allow SSH before enabling it.
